title: Mason Introduces the Macro32 Adventure Hardtail At Bespoked Dresden
content:
At Bespoked Dresden 2026, Mason will be introducing their new Macro32 adventure hardtail. The Macro32 is the first 32″ bike of its kind from a UK brand, and probably the first like this in the world.

The Macro32 is a UK-designed, Italian-made, premium aluminium adventure & bikepacking hardtail. It is designed to be highly configurable, with different routing options (integrated or internal), purpose-made carrying accessories (Condenser rack or Shutter load-bearing fender), and fork type (rigid Hotshoe2 carbon fork or suspension fork options).

This is not a concept bike. Mason has identified true potential, and we are in serious development, with a view to adding the Macro32 to their range for 2027. Ride testing in some of the world’s toughest bike packing races is next, then we aim to refine geometry and features and introduce the Macro32 for pre-order as part of regular small-batch production in Italy.

Why The Macro

The ‘Fast, light, configurable, long-distance adventure’ nature of the Macro, lends itself perfectly to the inherent advantages of a large fast-rolling wheel. Also, the long adventure-hardtail geometry works much more naturally with the very large overall diameter of 32″ x 2.4″ wheels. We can design 3 sizes – XL, Large & Med [Sml will probably remain 29″ – it’s still a very fast wheel!] without using ‘tortured looking’ geometry and making compromises in rider fit, riding efficiency and clearances.

The Macro32 draws on what they have learnt from the development of the existing Macro29, using similar Aluminium tubing from Dedacciai in Italy, but uses totally new geometry. 32″ wheels offer big potential, but also have unique design challenges. They don’t want to lose the engaging and dependable ride feel of the Macro, purely for ‘straight line speed’. Keeping the rider-compartment similar to the Macro29 is key here, along with keeping BB height, wheelbase and trail angles in check.

New seatstay, chainstay and seat tube design were all necessary, once again carried out in conjunction with the master tube makers at Dedacciai, Italy.

The Fork

Our MASON ‘HotShoe2’ carbon fork is key here. Originally designed for the MASON ISO, it was developed for large wheel adventure cycling and required the capacity for 29″ x 2.6″ or 27.5″ x 3″ wheels and tyres. Unique to MASON and designed and tooled them, this fork also has the clearance for our special load-bearing fender, the MASON ‘Shutter’. Along with our ‘Condenser’ rack, the accessories fit direct to our crown-mounted ‘Tri Mount’ system.

Because we built in huge clearance for the fender and large tyres, the HotShoe fork has plenty of capacity and clearance for the current crop of tyres, up to 32″ x 2.4″.

Hunt and Mason

Mason has worked closely with UK wheel brand Hunt, since the first days of Mason in 2014.  Now, Mason is very proud to be the brand to help introduce the HUNT Proven 32″ development wheelset. Once again, we were thinking along similar lines and working on boost-spacing MTB spec 32″ wheels for fast adventure.

Tailfin 32

Also introducing the new 32” adaptors for the Tailfin Speedpack. This is the first time that this new variation has been seen at a bike show.

Show Bike Spec:

  • Mason Macro32 XL frameset, with HotShoe2 carbon fork. Built to ride-fit dimensions for Josh Ibbett.
  • Mason Condenser2 fork-crown mounted rack.
  • Hunt Proven 32″ Development carbon wheelset.
  • Scwalbe Race Pro, Rick Speed 32x 2.4″ tyres.
  • Ritchey Switch stem and Superlogic carbon bars.
  • XTR/XT build with 28t chainring and 10/52t cassette.
  • New Tailfin Speedpack 32″

Geometry for Macro32 Development XL:

  • ST C/T: 505
  • VTT: 631
  • HT: 125
  • Stack: 635
  • Reach: 482
  • HA: 67º
  • SA: 76º
  • Rear Centre: 455
  • WB: 1212
  • BB drop: 93
  • Fork A/C: 485.6

Weight: For XL Macro32 as shown [with pedals and front rack/without Tailfin Speedpack] – 11.5kg
